Problem Statement:
Given an array of numbers and another number k. Find whether K exists and the number of time k repeats. If it does not exist just print no. 
Input Description:
Input Size : |N| <= 1000000 
Sample Input:
5 3
3 3 4 4 7 
Sample Output:
yes 2
